The agent\n2639\t        # being invoked and replying is transport evidence, not a\n2640\t        # satisfaction judgment; the verdict belongs to an independent\n2641\t        # judge reading this matrix, never to the executor that carried\n2642\t        # the reply.\n2643\t        synthesized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n2644\t        excerpt = (agent_text or \"<agent produced no text>\").strip()\n2645\t        excerpt_short = excerpt[:240] + (\"...\" if len(excerpt) > 240 else \"\")\n2646\t        if must_satisfy:\n2647\t            for item in must_satisfy:\n2648\t                if not isinstance(item, dict):\n2649\t                    continue\n2650\t                cid = item.get(\"id\")\n2651\t                if not cid:\n2652\t                    continue\n2653\t                synthesized.append({\n2654\t                    \"id\": cid,\n2655\t                    \"verdict\": \"unverified\",\n2656\t                    \"evidence_refs\": [],\n2657\t                    \"evidence\": excerpt_short,\n2658\t                })\n2659\t        if not synthesized:\n2660\t            # Last-resort single-row matrix; agent_text is the only\n2661\t            # truthful evidence. The agent\n        # being invoked and replying is transport evidence, not a\n        # satisfaction judgment; the verdict belongs to an independent\n        # judge reading this matrix, never to the executor that carried\n        # the reply.\n        synthesized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n        excerpt = (agent_text or \"<agent produced no text>\").strip()\n        excerpt_short = excerpt[:240] + (\"...\" if len(excerpt) > 240 else \"\")\n        if must_satisfy:\n            for item in must_satisfy:\n                if not isinstance(item, dict):\n                    continue\n                cid = item.get(\"id\")\n                if not cid:\n                    continue\n                synthesized.append({\n                    \"id\": cid,\n                    \"verdict\": \"unverified\",\n                    \"evidence_refs\": [],\n                    \"evidence\": excerpt_short,\n                })\n        if not synthesized:\n            # Last-resort single-row matrix; agent_text is the only\n            # truthful evidence.
